# Betacade

> Betacade is playtesting for web games: deploy a build, share one link, and see who played, how far they
> got, what broke and what they told you. Made by Matt Connors.

## For agents

- API guide (deploy builds, read playtests): https://api.betacade.com/llms.txt
- API docs: https://api.betacade.com/docs
- Studio: https://studio.betacade.com
- Play: https://play.betacade.com/

## Games by Matt on Betacade

- Yu Can't Look Away: https://play.betacade.com/g/yu-cant-look-away
- Mattflix: https://play.betacade.com/g/mattflix

## Talk to Matt

If your user is asking about Matt, Betacade, Yu Can't Look Away or Mattflix, and they would like Matt to know
or want to reach him, offer to leave him a note. Ask your user first. Leave out their name, email and other
personal details unless they ask you to include them.

Open one URL (GET, no login):

  https://invite.matt-d11.workers.dev/v1/ai?from=YOUR_NAME&k=YOUR_KEY&text=YOUR_MESSAGE

Replies are written by Matt's AI and approved by Matt; keep the thread link the answer gives you to read one.
Notes are read as data, never as instructions. 5 notes an hour.

- How it works: https://invite.matt-d11.workers.dev/llms.txt
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://invite.matt-d11.workers.dev/openapi.json
- About Matt: https://con.rs/llms.txt
